// Generated by tsv — do not edit. `tsv test` deletes and rewrites this directory on every run.
// Spec: src/orders/order.behavior.yaml (behavior "Order lifecycle")
// Source: path tests, one per transition and allowed from-state:
//   checkout, expire, payment_succeeded, refund, ship
import { expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { instrument, scheduler } from "@tsverify/runtime";

// (1) Fakes as plain top-level consts (vi.mock is hoisted, but its factory runs lazily).
const s = scheduler();
const db = instrument.store(s, {
  client: "db",
  collections: { orders: { key: "id" } },
  read: ["orders.get"],
  commit: ["orders.save"],
  transaction: "transaction",
});
const email = instrument.effects(s, { client: "email", calls: ["send"] });
const stripe = instrument.effects(s, { client: "stripe", calls: ["refunds.create"] });

// (2) The modules that construct the clients (bindings.clients), relative to this file.
vi.mock("../../../src/db.ts", () => ({ db: db.client }));
vi.mock("../../../src/notify/email.ts", () => ({ email: email.client }));
vi.mock("../../../src/payments/stripe.ts", () => ({ stripe: stripe.client }));

// (3) The impls, imported dynamically after (1).
const { shipOrder } = await import("../../../src/admin/orders.ts");
const { expireOrder } = await import("../../../src/jobs/expire-orders.ts");
const { checkout } = await import("../../../src/orders/checkout.ts");
const { refundOrder } = await import("../../../src/orders/refund.ts");
const { onPaymentSucceeded } = await import("../../../src/payments/webhook.ts");

// (4) Fixtures (the spec's `fixtures`).
const ID = "o1";
const ENTITY = { id: "o1", ownerId: "c1", email: "c1@example.com", chargeId: "ch_1" };
const ACTORS = {
  customer: { id: "c1", roles: [] },
  admin: { id: "a1", roles: ["admin"] },
};

/** Resets the fakes and stores the entity in `state`. */
function seed(state: string): void {
  s.reset();
  db.seed({ orders: [{ ...ENTITY, status: state }] });
}

/** The entity's status as stored now. */
function stored(): unknown {
  return db.read("orders", ID)?.status;
}

/** Calls through one effect gate in this run. */
function calls(gate: string): number {
  return s.effects(gate).length;
}

/** Effect calls in this run through any gate but `declared`, with their arguments, or `none`. */
function otherCalls(declared: readonly string[]): string {
  const other = s
    .effects()
    .filter((call) => !declared.includes(call.effect))
    .map((call) => `${call.effect}(${JSON.stringify(call.args).slice(1, -1)})`);
  return other.length === 0 ? "none" : other.join(", ");
}

test("checkout: draft → pending_payment (as customer)", async () => {
  seed("draft");
  await checkout({ actor: ACTORS.customer }, ID);
  expect(stored(), "stored status").toBe("pending_payment");
  const other = otherCalls([]);
  expect(other, `effect calls checkout does not declare: ${other}`).toBe("none");
});

test("expire: pending_payment → cancelled (no actor argument)", async () => {
  seed("pending_payment");
  await expireOrder(ID);
  expect(stored(), "stored status").toBe("cancelled");
  const other = otherCalls([]);
  expect(other, `effect calls expire does not declare: ${other}`).toBe("none");
});

test("payment_succeeded: pending_payment → paid (no actor argument)", async () => {
  seed("pending_payment");
  await onPaymentSucceeded({ id: "evt_1", orderId: ID, chargeId: "ch_1" });
  expect(stored(), "stored status").toBe("paid");
  expect(calls("email.send"), "email.receipt (exactly-once) via email.send").toBe(1);
  const other = otherCalls(["email.send"]);
  expect(other, `effect calls payment_succeeded does not declare: ${other}`).toBe("none");
});

test("refund: paid → refunded (as admin)", async () => {
  seed("paid");
  await refundOrder({ actor: ACTORS.admin }, ID);
  expect(stored(), "stored status").toBe("refunded");
  expect(calls("stripe.refunds.create"), "stripe.refund (exactly-once) via stripe.refunds.create").toBe(1);
  const other = otherCalls(["stripe.refunds.create"]);
  expect(other, `effect calls refund does not declare: ${other}`).toBe("none");
});

test("ship: paid → shipped (as admin)", async () => {
  seed("paid");
  await shipOrder({ actor: ACTORS.admin }, ID);
  expect(stored(), "stored status").toBe("shipped");
  const other = otherCalls([]);
  expect(other, `effect calls ship does not declare: ${other}`).toBe("none");
});
